spans.s:
मुशटी मुशटी, मुशल, मुशलिका, मुशलिन्.
See मुसटी, मुसल, मुसलिका, मुसलिन्.

मुसटी मुसटी, f. a white variety of Pani-
cum Italicum, (also read मुशटी.)

मुशल्लह मुशल्लह or मुसल्लह, an astro-
logical term (مصالحة).
मुसल्लह मुसल्लह. See मुशल्लह, col. 2.

मुष् 1. मुष्, cl. 1. P. मोषति, मोषि-
तुम्, = rt. मष्, to kill, q. v.

मुष् 2. मुष् [cf. rt. 1. मूष्], cl. 9. P.
मुष्णाति (rarely cl. 6. P. मुषति), मु-
मोष, मोषिष्यति, अमोषीत् (Ved. forms मो-
षति, मोषथ, मुषायते), मोषितुम्, to steal,
filch, pilfer, rob, plunder, seize, carry off; to steal,
away, tear away, ravish; to captivate, enrapture; to
surpass, excel; cl. 4. P. मुष्यति, मोषितुम्, = rt.
मुस्, to break, destroy, (according to the commen-
tator on Bhaṭṭi-kāvya
XV. 16

, where अमुषः is
explained by खण्डितवान् असि): Pass. मुष्यते:
Caus. मोषयति, Aor. अमूमुषत्: Desid. मु-
मुषिषति, -षितुम्, see Pāṇ.

: Intens.
मोमुष्यते, मोमोष्टि.

3. मुष्, ट्, f. stealing, theft; (ट्, ट्, ट्), robbing,
stealing, taking away (at the end of comps.); dis-
pelling (darkness, &c.); surpassing, excelling.

मुस् मुस् [cf. rt. 2. मुष्, cl. 4], cl. 4. P.
मुस्यति, &c., to break in pieces, cleave,
divide, cut, destroy.

मूष् 1. मूष् (= rt. 2. मुष्), cl. 1. P.
मूषति, मूषितुम्, to steal, rob, plunder.
2. मूष्, ट्, Ved. a mouse.
मुषक, अस्, m. a mouse, = मूषक, q. v.

मूषक, अस्, m. a thief; a rat, mouse; a kind
of metre; a particular part of the face; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a people; (इका), f. a rat, mouse, a female rat
or mouse; a species of leech; Salvinia Cucullata; a
crucible; (अका), f. a rat, mouse, female rat.
—मू-
षक-कर्णिका or मूषक-कर्णी or मूषक-
मारी, f. = मूषा-कर्णी, q. v.
—मूषकाद (˚क-
अद), अस्, m. ‘mouse-eater,’ N. of a Nāga.
—मूष-
काराति (˚क-अर्˚), इस्, m. ‘mouse's foe,’ a cat.
मुषा, f. = मूषा, a crucible.

मूष, अस्, आ or ई, m. f. a rat, mouse; (आ), f. a
crucible, (said to be also अस्, m. and ई, f.); Lipeo-
cercis Serrata; = गवाक्ष, a round window, air-
hole; [cf. Gr. μῦς; Lat. mus, mus-culu-s, mus-
cip-ula; Old Germ. mûs; Slav. mys-i.]
—मू-
षा-कर्णी, f. an aquatic plant, Salvinia Cucullata.
—मूषा-तुत्थ, अम्, n. a kind of vitriol.
—मू-
षी-करण, अम्, n. melting in a crucible.
मुषि, इस्, इस्, इ, stealing, &c. (in मनो-म्˚, q. v.).

मुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, stolen, robbed, plundered;
stript; deceived, cheated; ravished, carried off, torn
away, bereft of, deprived of, free from.
—मुषित-
चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, bereft of sense, deprived of con-
sciousness.
मूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, stolen, &c. = मुषित, q. v.

मुषितक, अस्, इका, अम्, stolen in a low or vile
manner; (अम्), n. stolen property.
मुषित्वा, ind. having stolen, having carried off, &c.

मुषीवन्, आ, m. (मुषीवाणम्, acc. c.), Ved. a
thief, robber.

मुष्क, अस्, m. (perhaps originally ‘a little mouse,’
fr. मुष् = 2. मूष् + क), a testicle; the scrotum;
a species of tree (= मुषक); a muscular or
stout person (= मांसल); a thief; a crowd, heap,
quantity, multitude, mass; (औ), m. du. pudenda
muliebria.
—मुष्क-कच्छू, ऊस्, f. an eruption on
the scrotum.
—मुष्क-देश, अस्, m. the region of
the scrotum.
—मुष्क-द्वय, अम्, n. the two
testicles.
—मुष्क-भार, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having
large testicles, (Sāy. = प्रवृद्ध-मुष्क.)
—मु-
ष्क-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having testicles; an
epithet of Indra as author of Ṛg-veda

.
—मुष्क-शून्य, अस्, m. ‘one who is without
testicles,’ a castrated person, eunuch, guard of the
women's apartments.
—मुष्क-शोफ, अस्, m. swell-
ing of the testicles.
—मुष्क-स्रोतस्, अस्, n. the vas
deferens (in anatomy).
—मुष्काबर्ह (˚क-आब्˚),
अस्, m., Ved. one who gelds or castrates.

मुष्कक, अस्, m. a species of tree (the ashes of
which are used as a cautery).

मुष्कर, अस्, आ, अम्, having testicles; (अस्), m.
a man with large testicles; a species of small animal
or insect (Atharva-veda

मुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, a rare form for मुषित,
q. v.; (अम्), n. theft, robbery.

मुष्टि, इस्, m. f. stealing, filching, pilfering; the
closed or clenched hand (perhaps originally ‘the
hand closed to grasp anything stolen’); the fist,
(गूढाङ्गुष्ठ-कृत-मुष्टि, the clenched fist
with the thumbs turned in); a fistful, handful [cf.
दर्भ-म्˚, कुश-म्˚, केश-म्˚, गाढ-म्˚]; a par-
ticular measure (= a handful = 1 Pala); a hilt or
handle (of a sword, &c.); a compendium, abridg-
ment; (according to Mahī-dhara on Vājasaneyi-s.
XXIII. 24

) the penis (= लिङ्ग); [cf. Old Germ.
fust; Angl. Sax. fyst.]
—मुष्टि-करण, अम्, n.
clenching the fist.
—मुष्टि-ता, f. firmness of grasp.
—मुष्टि-देश, अस्, m. the part of a bow which is
[]
grasped in the hand, the middle of a bow.
—मु-
ष्टि-द्यूत, अम्, n. a kind of game, odd or even,
(commonly called पुरमुट्खेला.)
—मुष्टिन्-
धम, अस्, ई, अम्, blowing into the closed hand.
—मुष्टिन्-धय, अस्, आ, अम्, sucking the fist
or closed hand; (अस्), m. a child, boy.
—मुष्टि-
पात, अस्, m. pummelling, boxing.
—मुष्टि-प्र-
हार, अस्, m. a blow with the fist.
—मुष्टि-बन्-
ध, अस्, m. clenching the fist, closing the hand (in
taking hold of anything); a handful.
—मुष्टि-
बन्धन, अम्, n. the act of clenching the fist.
—मुष्टि-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having a fist-like face.
—मुष्टि-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be measured or
spanned with the hand, (मध्येन मुष्टि-मेयेन,
with a waist which might be spanned with the
fingers.)
—मुष्टि-युद्ध, अम्, n. a fight with
fists, pugilistic encounter.
—मुष्टि-सङ्ग्राह-पी-
डित, अस्, आ, अम्, squeezed by a grasp with the fist,
griped.
—मुष्टि-हत्या, f., Ved. a hand to hand
engagement.
—मुष्टि-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ, Ved. fight-
ing hand to hand (said of common soldiers as opposed
to those who fought in chariots).
—मुष्टी-कृ, cl.
8. P. -करोति, &c., to close the hand, clench the fist.
—मुष्टी-कृत्य, ind. having clenched the fist.
—मुष्टी-मुष्टि, ind. fist to fist, hand to hand
fighting, fisticuffs.

मुष्टिक, अस्, m. a particular position of the
hands; a goldsmith; N. of an Asura; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of an outcast race, = डोम्बास्; (आ), f. the fist,
hand; (अम्), n. a fight with fists, pugilistic encounter,
fisticuffs.
—मुष्टिक-घ्न, अस्, m. ‘slayer of
Muṣṭika,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—मुष्टिक-स्वस्-
तिक, अस्, m. a particular position of the hands in
dancing.
—मुष्टिका-कथन, अम्, n. talking with
the fingers.
—मुष्टिकान्तक (˚क-अन्˚), अस्, m.
‘annihilator of Muṣṭika,’ an epithet of Bala-deva,
the brother of Kṛṣṇa.

मुष्णत्, अन्, अती, अत्, stealing, robbing, taking
away, depriving of; captivating; excelling, surpass-
ing, eclipsing.

मुष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being robbed, being
plundered.
मुस्तु, उस्, m. f. = मुष्टि, the fist.
मुस्तु मुस्तु. See p. 786, col. 3.
मुषल मुषल, मुषल्य. See मुसल, &c.

मुसल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (often spelt मुषल and
less correctly मुशल), a pestle, a kind of wooden
pestle used for cleaning rice; a mace, club, (चक्र-
मुसलः सङ्ग्रामः, a battle fought with discuses
and clubs); a particular surgical instrument; a par-
ticular constellation; the twenty-second astronomical
Yoga or division of the moon's path; N. of a son of
Viśvāmitra; (ई), f. the plant Curculigo Orchioides;
Salvinia Cucullata; the house-lizard.
—मुसला-मु-
सलि, ind. club against club.
—मुसलायुध (˚ल-
आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, club-armed; (अस्), m. an epithet of
Bala-deva.
—मुसली-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भ-
वितुम्, to become a club.
—मुसलोलूखल (˚ल-
उल्˚), अम्, n. a pestle and mortar.
मुष्ठक मुष्ठक, अस्, m. black mustard.

मुसलक, अस्, m., N. of a mountain; (इका), f. a
common lizard.
मुसलित, अस्, आ, अम्, see Gaṇa Tārakādi to Pāṇ.

मुसलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a club; (ई), m. an
epithet of Śiva; of Bala-deva.

मुसलीय or मुसल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, deserving to be
pounded to death or to be put to death with a club.

मुस्र, अम्, n. a pestle; a tear (in this sense =
अश्रु, q. v.).
मुस्र मुस्र. See p. 786, col. 3.

मुसारगल्व मुसारगल्व, coral or a kind of
white coral.

मुस्त् मुस्त्, cl. 10. P. मुस्तयति, मुस्त-
यितुम्, to gather, collect, heap up, accu-
mulate.

मुस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. a species of grass,
Cyperus Rotundus; (अम्), n. the root of the Musta
grass; [cf. भद्र-म्˚.]
—मुस्त-गिरि, इस्, m., N.
of a mountain.
—मुस्ताद (˚त-अद or ˚त-आद),
अस्, m. ‘grass-eater,’ a hog, a wild boar.
—मुस्ताभ
(˚त-आभ्˚), अम्, n. a species of Cyperus.

मुस्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. a species of grass,
Cyperus Rotundus; (अस्), m. a particular vegetable
poison.

मूषण, अम्, n. the act of stealing, pilfering,
filching.

मूषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, stealing, filching, plun-
dering.

मूषिक, अस्, m. a thief, plunderer; a rat, mouse
[cf. गन्ध-मूषिक, महा-मूषिक]; Mimosa
Sirissa (= शिरीष); N. of a country (the part of
the Malabar coast between Quilon and Cape Como-
rin); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, (also read भू-
षिक); (आ), f., see under मूषक.
—मूषिक-
निर्विशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, not differing from a mouse,
the same as a mouse.
—मूषिक-पर्णी, f. an
aquatic plant, Salvinia Cucullata.
—मूषिक-रथ,
अस्, m. ‘rat-vehicled, riding on a rat,’ an epithet of
Gaṇeśa (see गणेश, p. 279).
—मूषिक-विषाण,
अम्, n. a mouse's horn, i. e. an impossibility; [cf. शश-
विषाण.]
—मूषिक-स्थल, अम्, n. (probably) a
mole-hill.
—मूषिकाङ्क (˚क-अङ्˚), अस्, m. ‘cha-
racterized by a rat,’ epithet of Gaṇeśa.
—मूषिकाञ्-
चन (˚क-अञ्˚), अस्, m. ‘going on a rat,’ an epithet
of Gaṇeśa.
—मूषिकाद (˚क-अद˚) = मूषकाद.
—मूषिका-दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, or मूषिका-दन्त,
अस्, आ or ई, अम्, ‘mouse-toothed,’ having the teeth
of a mouse.
—मूषिकान्तकृत् (˚क-अन्˚), त्, m.
‘mouse-destroyer,’ a cat.
—मूषिकाराति = मूष-
काराति.
—मूषिकाह्वय (˚क-आह्˚), अस्, m. Salvinia
Cucullata.
—मूषिकोत्कर (˚क-उत्˚) or ˚का-उत्˚), अस्,
m. a mole-hill.
मूषीक, अस्, आ, m. f. = मूषिक, a rat, mouse.

मूषिकका or मूषिकिका, f. (diminutive of मू-
षिका), a little rat or mouse.
मूषिकार, अस्, m. a male mouse.
मूषि-पर्णिका, f. = मूषिक-पर्णी, q. v.
—मूषीक-कर्णी, f. = मूषा-कर्णी, q. v.

मूष्यायण मूष्यायण, अस्, आ, अम्, born of
unknown parents, (probably for आमुष्यायण.)

मूसरिःफ मूसरिः-फ and मूसरीफ, अस्,
m., N. of the fourth Yoga.
